items.statement: On receipt and before acceptance, visually examine each container or group of containers of components, drug product containers and closures for correct labeling of contents, container damage or broken seals, and contamination.
items.quote: Upon receipt and before acceptance, each container or grouping of containers of components, drug product containers, and closures shall be examined visually for appropriate labeling as to contents, container damage or broken seals, and contamination.
items.condition: upon receipt, before acceptance

items.statement: Keep components, drug product containers and closures in quarantine until they have been tested or examined, as appropriate, and released.
items.quote: Components, drug product containers, and closures shall be stored under quarantine until they have been tested or examined, whichever is appropriate, and released.
items.condition: until tested or examined and released

items.statement: Store quarantined components, drug product containers and closures in the quarantine area in line with the general handling and storage requirements for these materials.
items.quote: Storage within the area shall conform to the requirements of § 211.80.

not_applicable.text: § 211.82 Receipt and storage of untested components, drug product containers, and closures.

items.statement: Withhold each lot of components, drug product containers and closures from use until it has been sampled, tested or examined, as appropriate, and released for use by the quality control unit.
items.quote: Each lot of components, drug product containers, and closures shall be withheld from use until the lot has been sampled, tested, or examined, as appropriate, and released for use by the quality control unit.
items.condition: until released by quality control unit

items.statement: Collect representative samples from each shipment of each lot for testing or examination.
items.quote: Representative samples of each shipment of each lot shall be collected for testing or examination.

items.statement: Base the number of containers sampled and the amount taken from each on appropriate criteria, such as statistical criteria for component variability, confidence levels and desired precision, the supplier's past quality history, and the quantity needed for analysis and for reserve samples where reserve samples are required.
items.quote: The number of containers to be sampled, and the amount of material to be taken from each container, shall be based upon appropriate criteria such as statistical criteria for component variability, confidence levels, and degree of precision desired, the past quality history of the supplier, and the quantity needed for analysis and reserve where required by § 211.170.
items.condition: reserve quantity where reserve samples are required

items.statement: When collecting samples, clean the selected component containers when necessary, in a way that prevents introducing contaminants into the component.
items.quote: The containers of components selected shall be cleaned when necessary in a manner to prevent introduction of contaminants into the component.
items.condition: when collecting samples; when necessary

items.statement: When collecting samples, open, sample and reseal containers in a way designed to prevent contamination of their contents and of other components, drug product containers or closures.
items.quote: The containers shall be opened, sampled, and resealed in a manner designed to prevent contamination of their contents and contamination of other components, drug product containers, or closures.
items.condition: when collecting samples

items.statement: When collecting samples, use sterile equipment and aseptic sampling techniques when necessary.
items.quote: Sterile equipment and aseptic sampling techniques shall be used when necessary.
items.condition: when collecting samples; when necessary

items.statement: When collecting samples, if a component must be sampled from the top, middle and bottom of its container, do not composite those sample subdivisions for testing.
items.quote: If it is necessary to sample a component from the top, middle, and bottom of its container, such sample subdivisions shall not be composited for testing.
items.condition: when collecting samples; if top, middle and bottom sampling is necessary

items.statement: When collecting samples, identify sample containers so that the material name, lot number, source container, sampling date and name of the person who took the sample can be determined.
items.quote: Sample containers shall be identified so that the following information can be determined: name of the material sampled, the lot number, the container from which the sample was taken, the date on which the sample was taken, and the name of the person who collected the sample.
items.condition: when collecting samples

items.statement: When collecting samples, mark the containers that have been sampled to show that samples were removed from them.
items.quote: Containers from which samples have been taken shall be marked to show that samples have been removed from them.
items.condition: when collecting samples

items.statement: When examining and testing samples, perform at least one test to verify the identity of each drug product component.
items.quote: At least one test shall be conducted to verify the identity of each component of a drug product.
items.condition: when examining and testing samples

items.statement: When examining and testing samples, use specific identity tests for components where such tests exist.
items.quote: Specific identity tests, if they exist, shall be used.
items.condition: when examining and testing samples; if specific tests exist

items.statement: When examining and testing samples, test each component for conformity with all appropriate written specifications for purity, strength and quality.
items.quote: Each component shall be tested for conformity with all appropriate written specifications for purity, strength, and quality.
items.condition: when examining and testing samples

items.statement: When examining and testing samples, instead of performing the component specification testing yourself you may accept the supplier's report of analysis, provided you perform at least one specific identity test on the component and establish the reliability of the supplier's analyses by validating the supplier's test results at appropriate intervals.
items.quote: In lieu of such testing by the manufacturer, a report of analysis may be accepted from the supplier of a component, provided that at least one specific identity test is conducted on such component by the manufacturer, and provided that the manufacturer establishes the reliability of the supplier's analyses through appropriate validation of the supplier's test results at appropriate intervals.
items.condition: when examining and testing samples; provided identity test done and supplier results validated at appropriate intervals

items.statement: When examining and testing samples, test containers and closures for conformity with all appropriate written specifications.
items.quote: Containers and closures shall be tested for conformity with all appropriate written specifications.
items.condition: when examining and testing samples

items.statement: When examining and testing samples, instead of testing containers and closures yourself you may accept the supplier's certificate of testing, provided you perform at least a visual identification of the containers/closures and establish the reliability of the supplier's test results by validating them at appropriate intervals.
items.quote: In lieu of such testing by the manufacturer, a certificate of testing may be accepted from the supplier, provided that at least a visual identification is conducted on such containers/closures by the manufacturer and provided that the manufacturer establishes the reliability of the supplier's test results through appropriate validation of the supplier's test results at appropriate intervals.
items.condition: when examining and testing samples; provided visual identification done and supplier results validated at appropriate intervals

items.statement: When examining and testing samples, examine components microscopically when appropriate.
items.quote: When appropriate, components shall be microscopically examined.
items.condition: when examining and testing samples; when appropriate

items.statement: When examining and testing samples, examine each lot of a component, drug product container or closure that is liable to contamination with filth, insect infestation or other extraneous adulterant against established specifications for such contamination.
items.quote: Each lot of a component, drug product container, or closure that is liable to contamination with filth, insect infestation, or other extraneous adulterant shall be examined against established specifications for such contamination.
items.condition: when examining and testing samples; if liable to filth, insect or extraneous contamination

items.statement: When examining and testing samples, subject each lot of a component, drug product container or closure with potential for microbiological contamination that is objectionable for its intended use to microbiological tests before use.
items.quote: Each lot of a component, drug product container, or closure with potential for microbiological contamination that is objectionable in view of its intended use shall be subjected to microbiological tests before use.
items.condition: when examining and testing samples; if potential for objectionable microbiological contamination

items.statement: A lot of components, drug product containers or closures that meets the appropriate written specifications of identity, strength, quality and purity and the related sample examinations and tests may be approved and released for use.
items.quote: Any lot of components, drug product containers, or closures that meets the appropriate written specifications of identity, strength, quality, and purity and related tests under paragraph (d) of this section may be approved and released for use.
items.condition: if lot meets specifications and related tests

items.statement: Reject any lot of components, drug product containers or closures that does not meet the appropriate written specifications of identity, strength, quality and purity and the related tests.
items.quote: Any lot of such material that does not meet such specifications shall be rejected.
items.condition: if lot does not meet specifications

not_applicable.text: § 211.84 Testing and approval or rejection of components, drug product containers, and closures.
Samples shall be collected in accordance with the following procedures:
not_applicable.reason: lead-in; duties carried by sub-paragraph items

not_applicable.text: Samples shall be examined and tested as follows:
not_applicable.reason: lead-in; duties carried by sub-paragraph items

items.statement: Rotate approved components, drug product containers and closures so the oldest approved stock is used first; temporary and appropriate deviation from this rotation is permitted.
items.quote: Components, drug product containers, and closures approved for use shall be rotated so that the oldest approved stock is used first. Deviation from this requirement is permitted if such deviation is temporary and appropriate.
items.condition: unless deviation is temporary and appropriate

not_applicable.text: § 211.86 Use of approved components, drug product containers, and closures.

items.statement: Retest or reexamine approved components, drug product containers and closures, as appropriate, for identity, strength, quality and purity, and have the quality control unit approve or reject them under the same testing and approval requirements as on receipt, when necessary, for example after long storage or after exposure to air, heat or other conditions that might adversely affect them.
items.quote: Components, drug product containers, and closures shall be retested or reexamined, as appropriate, for identity, strength, quality, and purity and approved or rejected by the quality control unit in accordance with § 211.84 as necessary, e.g., after storage for long periods or after exposure to air, heat or other conditions that might adversely affect the component, drug product container, or closure.
items.condition: as necessary, e.g. after long storage or adverse exposure

not_applicable.text: § 211.87 Retesting of approved components, drug product containers, and closures.

items.statement: Identify rejected components, drug product containers and closures and control them under a quarantine system designed to prevent their use in manufacturing or processing operations for which they are unsuitable.
items.quote: Rejected components, drug product containers, and closures shall be identified and controlled under a quarantine system designed to prevent their use in manufacturing or processing operations for which they are unsuitable.

not_applicable.text: § 211.89 Rejected components, drug product containers, and closures.
